Very well. I'll tell you. I'm searching for the strongest sword.
Why? Because I want to become stronger. What other reason is there?
I hate weaklings. Weakness accomplishes nothing.
If you can't protect anything, there's no meaning in being alive.
...I've wasted enough time. I'm leaving.
That creature has calmed down. It probably won't rampage again.
If you have something you want to protect, don't rely entirely on your companions.
...You should at least learn how to handle a sword.

I'll tell you. It's because I
need to be powerful. There's nothing I despise more than weaklings, and
I refuse to be beaten by anyone. That's why I
need the strongest sword. I won't allow anyone

the way... I think you should also learn how to wield a sword.

rows.current:
The arena is divided by strength into Classes C through S.
Win three matches in a class to become its champion!
Each class championship earns you a magic key!
You'll also need money to enter.
You can't use items in arena battles, and choosing to flee counts as a loss.
rows.gameboy:
Your party may enter in battles ranging from the

 A Magic Key is the champ's prize. 
 You can't use any items in battle. And you forfeit if you flee.

rows.current:
Long ago, a master craftsman made a mirror while mourning his wife's death.
The round mirror glowed eerily. It was crafted so perfectly...
...that it gained the terrible power to destroy whatever it reflected.
Word of the mirror soon spread, and people feared it greatly.
They took it from the craftsman and threw it into the sea!
Overcome with grief, the man plunged into the sea himself to find it...
They say the mirror eventually reached the mermaids, who sealed it away.
But no one ever learned what became of the man.
rows.gameboy:
*: Long ago, a deft craftsman made a mirror with the power of darkness.
It brought ruin to whatever its cold face reflected.
Learning of this mirror, the people
grew frightened. They took the mirror from
the craftsman. It was hurled into the sea. The craftsman, out
of sorrow, leapt after the mirror into the sea.
The mirror drifted to the lair of mermaids where it was kept under secure
seal as the HarMirror. And that's the tale.

rows.current:
This happened back when I was a reckless young man.
Pirates attacked the ship I was on and took me prisoner.
After that... they worked me to the bone, day after day.
One day, I overheard the pirates talking.
They said stealing the Moonstone from the lighthouse would make the sea recede...
...so no one could reach Volcano Island, where they'd hidden their treasure.
They wouldn't let me live long if they knew I'd heard their secret...
So I slipped away while they weren't looking and jumped into the sea.
When I came to, another ship had rescued me.
rows.gameboy:
It was in my callow youth... The ship I was on was captured 
 by pirates who kept us as slaves. We toiled for months 
 that way. But one day, I overheard them talking about the MoonRock. 
 If it were taken from the top of the lighthouse, 
 the sea would ebb. And that would make it impossible 
 to approach the volcanic island where they hid their loot. 
 Unfortunately, they saw me. They would never allow someone to 
 live knowing their secret. So I ran and leapt into the sea. 
 I was rescued by a passing ship.

{PLAYER}は 自分が泉の精霊から この世界を救うよう 頼まれたこと...

この話には 西の国の王も ユナ姫も おどろきを隠すことは できませんでした。
西の国の王は 出陣をすぐさま取りやめ 北の国の王に 和平の使者を送りました。
こうして{PLAYER}のかつやくにより 2つの国の争いは 終わりをむかえ...
両国の王は 国境の鉱山で会う約束を かわしたのでした。

rows.current:
...Huh? What am I...?
...I finally remember. I'm Yuna, the princess of this kingdom.
Yuna: I saw a man dressed in black talking to a monster in the forest...
Yuna: That's right! They caught me listening to them.
Yuna: Then the monster stole my soul and took control of me.
Yuna: What were that man and the monster talking about...?
Yuna: Yes! Now I remember! They planned to steal the Sky Shield!
Yuna: They wanted to make people fight so the spirit of the spring would lose its power!
rows.gameboy:
I've finally remembered.
I'm Yuna, the King's daughter.
I'd overheard a man and monsters concocting a criminal plan in the forest,
but they found me.
A monster drained my soul, and my body was put under
its control. Their plan was diabolical!
They wanted to steal the Sky Shield from the elemental spirit, so they
tried to create strife among people to weaken the spirit.

rows.japanese_gbc_dqm1:
<PLAYER>は ほんだなを しらべた。

「わが まものの けんきゅう…

「まものには けいとうごとに
 とくちょうが あるのだ。
「たとえば スライムけいは
 すばやさが あがりやすい。
「また ボミオスや ルカニなどの
 ほじょけいじゅもんに つよい。
「あくまけいや ドラゴンけいには
 ひのまほうが ききにくい…。
「これらの とくちょうを すべて
 もつ まものを わたしは ほしい！

rows.japanese_psx:
「タイジュの秘密...
「タイジュをはじめ 他の国々も 大きな木の中に できている。
「木は育ち やがて 枯れる。 国にも じゅみょうが あるのだ。
「カレキという国は ほとんど 枯れてしまっているという......。
「だが 枯れる木があれば 生まれてくる 木もある。
「なぜか 星降りの夜に 新たな木が 生まれてくることが多い......。

rows.current:
The Secret of GreatTree...
GreatTree and several other kingdoms are built inside enormous trees.
Trees grow, and eventually they wither. Kingdoms, too, have a lifespan.
The kingdom of Kareki is said to have almost completely withered...
But as some trees wither, others are born.
For some reason, new trees are often born on the night of the Starry Night tournament...
rows.gameboy:
:The secret of GreatTree...

 inside big trees. :Trees grow and die. Thus, there is a

 :However, it seems many new trees are born on the Starry Night.
rows.delocalized:
'The Secret of Great Tree:
Not only Great Tree, but several other kingdoms exist within giant trees.
Trees grow and die, therefore a tree kingdom has a natural life span.
The aptly named Dead Tree is almost at the end of its cycle.
As trees die, new ones replace them.
It seems many new trees are born on the Night of the Shooting Stars.'

I'm the old man who took you to the castle when you first came to GreatTree.
People call me the Monster Elder.
This is the Starry Shrine, where monsters are bred and hatched.
Breeding means marrying one monster to another.
When they marry, they produce an egg.
Hatching means bringing a monster out of that egg.
...What brings you here today?
rows.gameboy:
Oh, long time no see! Remember me? I am the old man 
 who took you to the castle when you first came to GreatTree. 
 People call me Master Monster Tamer. 
 This is the Shrine of Starry Night. 
 It is the place for breeding monsters and hatching eggs. 
 Breeding is the wedding of monsters. 
 When they are wed, an egg is laid. Eggs hatch into monsters. 
 What can I do for you today?
rows.delocalized:
Oh, long time no see! Remember me? I'm the one who brought 
 you to the castle when you first came to Great Tree. 
 People call me the Monster Elder. And this is the Shrine of 
 Shooting Stars, where we breed monsters and 
 hatch their eggs. Breeding is what happens when two 
 monsters are paired together. After breeding, an 
 egg will be laid. That egg will hatch and produce a new monster. 
 Well, what can I do for you?

rows.current:
Chirp, chirp! Here's a useful tip. When you breed monsters...
...the child belongs to the family of the parent you choose for its pedigree!
Pedigrees and families... It sounds a little confusing, but...
...if you want to make a slime-family monster...
...choose a slime for the pedigree!
If you want to make a dragon-family monster...
...choose a dragon for the pedigree!
In other words, the child takes after the parent you choose for its pedigree.

rows.current:
After breeding, the parent monsters disappear.
But their skills are passed on to their child.
For example, breed a dragon-family monster with a Healer Slime, using the dragon for the pedigree...
...and you'll get a Dragon Kid that can learn Heal.
Raise that Dragon Kid, then breed it with another monster...
Keep breeding like that, and you'll make powerful monsters!
rows.gameboy:
After breeding, the parent monsters will go back to the wild. 
 But the skills of the parents will be passed on to the kids. 
 For an example, when a Dragon is chosen as the pedigree and 
 bred with a Healer, a DragonKid that can learn Healer's 
 skills will be born. Raise the DragonKid and breed it with another monster... 
 and so on. You can make many strong monsters this way!
rows.delocalized:
Parent monsters will go back to the wild after breeding, 
 but their skills will be passed down to the offspring. 
 For example, when a Dragon is the pedigree and bred with Heali Slime, 
 a Dragon Whelp that can learn Heali Slime's skills will be born. 
 If you raise that Dragon Whelp and go on to breed its offspring, 
 you will be able to make some very powerful new monsters.

わしも かつて わたぼうに 連れられて こっちに来たんじゃ。

rows.current:
Watabou once brought me to this world, too.
I became a master and won the tournament.
The spirit of GreatTree born on that Starry Night...
...must be raising a new GreatTree sapling somewhere by now.
Eventually that sapling will grow into a great tree.
A huge, huge tree, just like this kingdom!
rows.gameboy:
I also was brought here by Watabou a long time ago. 
 I became a master & won a victory in the tournament. 
 Spirits born on the Starry Night.. 
 must be growing new saplings of GreatTree somewhere by now. 
 Eventually the saplings will grow & become a big tree. 
 A big tree just like this kingdom!
rows.delocalized:
I was also brought here by Fluffling a long time ago.
I became a master and won in the Shooting Star Tournament.
The spirit born on the Night of the Shooting Stars
must be cultivating the sprout of a new Great Tree by now.
Eventually, the sprout will become a giant tree,
just like this kingdom!

rows.current:
You... There's nothing more I can teach you.
You've grown wonderfully. You and your monsters alike...!
All that's left is to befriend every monster...
But the road will be a hard one.
There are 312 species in all. I never managed it myself...
rows.gameboy:
You...! I have nothing to say. 
 You & your monsters grew up to be great. Only thing left 
 for you is to tame all the monsters.. 
 But it isn't easy.. 
 There are 312 kinds of them. I couldn't do it..
rows.delocalized:
You! What can I even say?
Both you and your companions have grown to be so powerful.
The only thing left for you to do is to tame every monster.
But it's not easy.
There are 312 different monster species to be tamed. Even I haven't been able to accomplish that.

rows.current:
King: Become a master and win the Starry Night tournament, of course!!
King: Legend says that the winner can have any dream come true.
King: Surely your dream of seeing your sister will come true as well!
King: Hmm, I've tied that together rather neatly, if I do say so myself.
King: In any case, the fact that Watabou brought you here...
King: ...means you have the talent to be a master.
King: Now! I shall give you a monster.
King: You can't do a master's work without one!
King: Go right from the castle entrance to reach the monster farm.
King: Ask a fellow called Pulio there to give you a monster.
King: Once you've received one, come back here.
rows.gameboy:
King:Win the tournament of the Starry Night!
King:Legend has it that the one who is victorious in
the tournament of the Starry Night will be granted a wish.
King:Your wish to find your
sister will be granted! King:That way we both win...
King:Meanwhile, search for your sister while you prepare
for the tournament! King:Here, I shall
give you some monsters. King:Without any monsters,
you cannot serve as a master! King:The monster farm
is to the right of the castle entrance.
King:Go and ask Pulio for your monsters.
rows.delocalized:
I need you to enter into the Shooting Star Tournament and become the
new champion! Legend has it that the victor of the Shooting Star Tournament will
be granted a wish. Your goal of
finding your sister will be achieved!
I'd call that a win-win situation! Meanwhile, you can
search for your sister while you prepare for the tournament.
Now, let me give you
some monsters. You're going to need monsters if you want to
be a monster master! The monster farm is to
the right of the castle entrance.
Go there and ask Pulio for your monsters.

rows.current:
After forty-seven full moons, Starry Night arrives.
Hundreds, thousands of stars...
...rain down until they all but cover the heavens.
Millions, tens of millions of stars...
...blanket the earth with fragments of light.
Starry Night.
A night when countless lives rain down...
To celebrate this night, a grand contest of skill is held.
This contest is the Starry Night fighting tournament.
rows.gameboy:
The Starry Night comes after every 47th full moon.
Hundreds of thousands of stars
fall and fill the sky.
Fragments of light
cover the world.
That's the Starry Night.
The night when countless lives shower down.
To celebrate the night, the tournament is held.
This is the tournament of the Starry Night.
rows.delocalized:
The Night of the Shooting Stars comes after every 47th full moon.
Hundreds of thousands of falling stars
fill the sky,
and the entire world is enveloped
in a tapestry of light.
When the ancient poets looked upon this starlight,
they compared it to the radiance of life itself.
A great tournament is held to celebrate this night.
We call it the Shooting Star Tournament.

rows.current:
Entering a Travelers' Gate sends you to another world.
In those worlds, you'll find mysterious holes...
...that take you to the next floor when you enter them.
Defeat the monster on the final floor, and you should be able to return!
If you want to see a map of where you've walked during your adventure...
...press the Square button. That only works while you're in another world.
rows.gameboy:
When you enter the Travelers' Gates, you will be sent to an 
 alien world. There are magical holes in the mystic world and 
 you can warp to the next level of the world through the holes. 
 You should be able to come back when you defeat the monster on the last level. 
 During the adventure, if you want to see the map of where you've been, 
 press the Square button. But it works only when you are in the mystic world.
rows.delocalized:
When you enter a travel gate, you'll be sent to a mystic world. 
 There are special holes in those worlds, 
 through which you can warp to the next floor. You can return 
 when you defeat the monster on the deepest floor. If you want to check 
 the map of where you've been on any floor, press the Square button. 
 You can only check your map while in the mystic worlds.

 because the Night of the Shooting Stars is drawing near. 
 I envy you greatly, for my kingdom has already withered. 
 Nevertheless, there is a certain beauty to be found in withered things. 
 When I observe closely, your kingdom may be excessively 
 jubilant. Nobody here seems to have their feet planted on the ground.

rows.current:
There were Baby Dragons, Giant Chickens, Dragon Kids and Evil Seeds...
Also Baby Satans, Spotted Slimes and Rotting Corpses.
Evil Seed uses Paralyze Hit!
If everyone is paralyzed, your party is wiped out. Don't forget Moonworts!
The boss is Treeface. It will curse you.
Curses are a nuisance, but a Laurel Leaf should cure them.
Plant-family monsters are weak against fire attacks!
rows.gameboy:
There were MiniDraks, BigRoosts, EvilSeeds, Demonites, 
 SpotSlimes and Horks living there. When all of your monsters 
 are paralyzed you're finished. 
 Don't forget some MoonHerbs! The guardian there is the 
 FaceTree. It will cast a curse. A curse is a real threat. 
 Use Laurels to cure curses. The monsters in the 
 plant family are vulnerable to fire attacks!
rows.delocalized:
There were Kidras, Spotted Slimes, Evil Seeds, Rotting 
 Corpses, Baby Satans, and Big Fowls living there. 
 When all of your monsters are paralyzed, you're 
 finished. Take some Full Moon Herbs! 
 The guardian there is a Face Tree. Its curses are a real threat. 
 Use Laurels to recover. Monsters in the 
 Plant family are vulnerable to fire attacks!

rows.current:
There were Snail Slimes, Minons, Gappurins and Dead Peckers...
Also Giant Eyeballs, Bubble Slimes and Mummies.
Some monsters use Paralyze Hit and Poison Hit, so take care.
The boss there is Funky Bird.
It uses Confusion Dance to confuse you!
The item that cures confusion is an Angel Bell.
rows.gameboy:
*:There were Snailys, Saccers, Gulpples, MadPeckers, *:EyeBalls,
Babbles, & Mummys living there. *:Beware of monsters
with Paralyze & PoisonHit. *:You might want to take
monsters with Antidote & NumbOff.

rows.delocalized:
There were Big Optis, Grapples, Snail Slimes, Bubble Slimes, Dead Peckers,
Embalmeds, and Bagwams living there. Beware of monsters
with attacks like Numb Hit and Poison Hit. You should take monsters that can
use Curii and Curiku. The guardian is
a Funky Bird. It will confuse you by dancing Optipani Dance!
You'll need an Angel's Bell to cure confusion.

rows.current:
Sometimes a defeated monster joins you after battle...
But feeding it meat greatly increases the chance of that happening.
The more expensive the meat, the more effective it is.
If one piece isn't enough, give it two or three.
Most importantly, defeat the monster you want last.
Only the last monster you defeat can join you.
rows.gameboy:
Sometimes monsters you beat will become your pal. 
 They are more likely to become your pal if you give them 
 meat treats. Pricey treats are better. 
 If one doesn't work, give them two or three. 
 It's important you defeat the monster you want last. 
 Only the monster defeated last will become your pal.
rows.delocalized:
Sometimes, monsters you beat will want to join you.

 feed them. Pricey meat is always better. 
 If one doesn't work, give them two or three. 
 It's important to defeat the monster you want last. 
 Only the monster defeated last can join you.

rows.current:
If you breed your pedigree monster with another from the same family...
You will usually get the same species.
In other words, you'll get an egg of the monster whose sex you want to change.
Then, if you have the egg appraiser examine that egg...
You can use a blessing to give it whichever sex you want!
The end result is the same as changing the monster's sex.

rows.current:
I'm Mickey. My fans are so noisy, it's a real nuisance.
Breeding two weak monsters doesn't gain you very much.
I think it's best to make them as strong as possible first.
Here's why...
The child's stats, like strength, HP and MP...
Are determined by the parents' average values.
If they're high at level 1, they'll keep climbing from there.
That's much better than starting at level 1 with low stats.
rows.gameboy:
I'm Mick. Those clingy fans are annoying. 
 Breeding between weaklings is not useful. It's better to breed trained monsters. 
 HP, MP, and other values of the newborns, 
 are determined by the average of 
 their parents'. If the newborns have a high HP, 
 MP, and other values at level 1, the newborns 
 can quickly inrease their levels. So, this is much 
 better than starting from level 1 with low values.
rows.delocalized:
I'm Mickey. Those clingy fans are annoying. 
 By the way, breeding weak monsters is a waste of time. 
 It's better to breed trained monsters. 
 The baby's stats will be half of 
 the average of their parents'. 
 If the newborns have high stats at level 1, they 
 can be raised easily. That's much better 
 than starting from level 1 with low values.

*「そして Sクラスを勝ち抜けば 大会に出る資格が 得られますよ。

*「また 道具を使うことも 許されません。
*「にげるを えらぶと 試合を ほうきしたと みなされます。
*「参加もうしこみは 左の受付で おこなってください。

rows.current:
Classes run from S, the strongest, down to G.
You face three masters in each class.
Defeat the third master, and your class goes up.
Clear Class S, and you qualify for the tournament.
You cannot give your monsters direct orders during matches.
Using items is also forbidden.
Choosing Run Away counts as forfeiting the match.
Please register at the desk on the left.
rows.gameboy:
The battle classes go from S,A down to G for beginners. 
 You'll fight 3 masters per class. 
 You can go to the next class when you defeat the 3rd master. 
 If you survive S class, you're eligible for the Starry Night Tournament. 
 During the battle, you can not give commands 
 to the monsters. You can not use any 
 items either. If you choose to RUN, you give up the battle. 
 To register, go to the receptionist on the left.
rows.delocalized:
The arena classes range from G for beginners all the way to the top tier of S.
You'll fight three masters per class.
You can go to the next class when you defeat the third master.
If you conquer S Class, you're eligible for the Shooting Star Tournament.
You can't give commands to your monsters during arena battles,
nor can you use any items.
If you choose to 'RUN', you forfeit the battle.
To register, go to the receptionist on the left.

rows.current:
Sage's Stones and Yggdrasil Dew restore HP.
Both restore HP to everyone.
You can use a Sage's Stone several times, but it will eventually break.
Magic Water restores MP.
A Yggdrasil Leaf brings a dead companion back to life.
Rib is tastier than Pork Chop.
A Silence Staff seals enemy magic with a strange mist.
A Seek Herb reveals the surrounding terrain.
With a Travel Bookmark, you can save in your adventure log anywhere!

A SageStone and WorldDew recover HP. Both recover HP for all. 
 You can use a SageStone several 
 times but it'll eventually break. 
 You can restore MP with a Potion. A WorldLeaf 
 brings back knocked out monsters. Ribs are a 
 better treat than PorkChops. A MistStaff blocks 
 an enemy's magic with a mysterious mist. 
 A MapHerb allows you to see the map around you. 
 A BookMark allows you to record in the Journal anytime.

Both Sage's Stone and World Tree Dew recover the party's HP.

Have a monster read an Adventure Book to make it brave.
A Scary Story Book makes it cowardly.
A Kindness Book makes it kind.
A Slyness Book makes it coldhearted.
A Clear Mind Book makes it thoughtful.
A Humor Book makes it foolish!
But be careful: reading one book might not be enough!

rows.current:
Surachi: You can leave up to 30 monsters on the farm.
Surachi: Eggs count too, so be careful.
Surachi: Monsters left here receive a little experience as well.
Surachi: But if you rarely take them along, they become less obedient.
Surachi: And monsters in hibernation...
Surachi: Don't receive experience, so keep that in mind!
rows.gameboy:
You can drop off up to 30 monsters and eggs here. 
 Be careful, eggs are counted too. 
 You can still get a little bit of experience even if you 
 leave the monsters here. But if you leave them here all 
 the time, they won't obey you. Remember, sleeping 
 monsters ...don't get any experience.
rows.delocalized:
You can drop off up to 30 monsters here - 
 and that includes eggs! Monsters on 
 the farm still get some experience when you 
 battle, but if you leave them here for too long, they won't 
 obey you anymore. And remember, sleeping 
 monsters don't get any experience!

rows.current:
Hi, {PLAYER}. Welcome.
Pulio has put me in charge of the monster barn.
Talk to me whenever you want to leave one of your monsters there.
Monsters sleep the whole time they're in the barn...
So they gain no experience, but their Wildness doesn't increase either.
Well, want to try putting a sleepy monster into hibernation?

policy: Japanese extract record spans are verified against the manifest's original ROM hashes before use.
